subject: general
question: Who said "The Directive Principle of state Policy is a Novel feature" of the Indian constitution?
solution:
The correct answer is__** B.R. Ambedkar**__.

__
 
• Dr. Bhimrao Ambedkar said that the directive principle of state policy is a novel feature of the Indian Constitution. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information:__**

 
• Dr. Bhimrao Ambedkar was an Indian Jurist, the Economist, and Leader of the Dalits Community.
 
• He was born on 14th April 1891 in the low cast Mahar family.
 
• He was a Law minister of the Government of India in 1947.
 
• He took a leading part in the framing of the Indian constitution.
